resolution.note: pre-tool hook refuses kill fed by pgrep -f and pkill -f; dispatch test proves it

title: Hook refuses kill fed by pgrep -f, which can match the caller's own shell
body:
On 2026-11-17 the lead ran kill $(pgrep -f zk8-regrade2.sh) and killed its own shell (exit 144): pgrep -f matched the calling command line. The hook refuses pgrep wait loops (t-avtyjt7) but not kill fed by pgrep -f.
Outcome: the PreToolUse Bash hook refuses (exit code 2 decision deny) a command that feeds kill from pgrep -f or runs pkill -f, naming PIDs from ps as the alternative; pass/fail in one dispatch test.
Proof: node --test test/hook/dispatch.test.ts with 'kill $(pgrep -f x.sh)' asserts the refusal.
Files: src/hook/, test/hook/dispatch.test.ts
